subject: [PATCH 1/3] mm/page_alloc: drop the pcp lock before enabling IRQs after a drain

2026-11-25.patch_summary: This patch addresses a performance issue in the Linux kernel's page allocation code by restoring IRQs only after dropping the per-cpu (pcp) lock, rather than enabling them while still holding the pcp lock. This prevents softirqs from failing to acquire the pcp lock and falling back to taking zone->lock, which can lead to contention and performance issues. The patch also includes a test case that demonstrates the improvement in throughput and callback duration on a 128-vCPU guest system.
